mechanism: Local Mac multipart POST to Matrix WLED /update using the exact Release07 BIN
host_error: The existing upload helper raised ota-response-not-confirmed-no-retry; it did not preserve a response file or stderr details.
post_attempt_readonly: POST_OTA_READONLY.json shows exact candidate identity remained installed at uptime 307s; no reboot or firmware change was observed.
resolution: Transferred the already hash-verified exact Release07 BIN to Opal over key-authenticated SSH, verified size and SHA there, then made one multipart /update request from Opal to Matrix. HTTP 200 and WLED Update successful response; seq34 runtime identity and health verification passed.
